speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Amoxicillin-induced acute generalized exanthematous pustulosis (AGEP) or severe cutaneous adverse reaction.

The patient is an 8-year-old girl who developed a low-grade fever, itchy rash, and generalized joint pain two days after starting amoxicillin for acute sinusitis. The rash initially appeared in the antecubital and popliteal fossae before spreading to the trunk and distal extremities. I will request a complete blood count to evaluate for neutrophilia and eosinophilia, which are common in drug eruptions. I will also request dermatology images to assess for pustules or vesicles.
